# FG-DB-0002

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`db-unavailable`](../../ops/runbooks/db-unavailable.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_slow_statement_is_db_query_failed_with_sqlstate_57014` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: データベースの処理に失敗しました。管理者に連絡してください。
- en: A database operation failed. Contact the administrator.
- id: Operasi basis data gagal. Hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

A statement failed on a working connection: it exceeded database.statement_timeout_ms (SQLSTATE 57014) or database.lock_timeout_ms (55P03), lost a serialization race (40001) or a deadlock (40P01), violated a constraint (23xxx), found no row where one must exist, or the server reported another error. (A lost connection is FG-DB-0001.)

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `query` (a static name of the statement — never its SQL text or parameters), `reason` (statement_timeout, lock_timeout, serialization, deadlock, constraint with `constraint` / `table`, row_not_found, change_timeout (a ChangeTx exceeded its 30 s deadline from begin to commit and was rolled back; see `timeout_ms`), subtree_unstable (a namespace move kept finding new children below its subtree while locking it, D5), tombstone_changed (a tombstone release found the tombstone changed — its target purged — after taking its path lock); deadlock, serialization, subtree_unstable and tombstone_changed carry `retryable=true`: the transaction was rolled back and the whole request may be retried, commit_outcome_unknown (COMMIT of a change did not answer within 10 s: the change may or may not be durable — check forge.audit_log for its request_id before retrying), rollback_timeout / a failed `change.rollback` (logged at warn after a dedup hit: the change itself is still Deduped, the connection may be unhealthy), write_on_read_pool (25006 on the read pool: a write was sent to the read-only forge_ro pool — a bug, never retried), permission_denied (42501: the role lacks the privilege — a bug or a missing GRANT, never retried), idle_in_transaction_timeout (25P03: the caller left a transaction idle; the session was ended — a caller bug), server_error, client_error — e.g. a decode error) and `sqlstate`. Row values are never logged: for classes 22 / 23 the server message is dropped. For timeouts, look for long-running or blocking sessions in pg_stat_activity and pg_locks at that time; look up other SQLSTATEs in the PostgreSQL documentation.

## 対処 (fix)

For timeouts remove the blocking session or fix the slow plan (EXPLAIN); serialization, deadlock, subtree_unstable and tombstone_changed (`retryable=true`) are safe to retry; commit_outcome_unknown is never retried blindly — look up the request_id in forge.audit_log first (a change without a dedup_key would be applied twice); for constraint and other states fix the caller named by `query`.
